args: Analyze the copy-on-write logic in spl_fixedarray_object_get_properties() in php-src/ext/spl/spl_fixedarray.c. Confirm whether the local HashTable *ht must be reassigned after intern->std.properties = zend_array_dup(ht), and identify any adjacent ownership/refcount or rebuild semantics that a correct minimal fix must preserve. Also note whether analogous code elsewhere demonstrates the intended pattern.

The reported ASan crash occurs after var_dump() rebuilds a large SplFixedArray's debug properties and later GC traverses a corrupt/stale properties table. The report states that when GC_REFCOUNT(ht) > 1, the function duplicates ht into intern->std.properties but continues inserting into and returning the old shared ht. The reproducer is PHP code `<?$a=new SplFixedArray(010001000);$b=$a;$c=$b;var_dump($c);`, with the crash in gc_mark_grey() after repeated zend_hash_packed_grow() calls from spl_fixedarray_object_get_properties(). I expect the root fix to assign the duplicate back to local ht, likely `ht = intern->std.properties = zend_array_dup(ht);`, while retaining the existing GC_DELREF. Please inspect exact source and related patterns and flag subtleties.
